condition: single 3'-terminal mismatch, by primer end (F3 / FIP / BLP)
axis: time-to-threshold delay versus the perfect-match template
outcome_definition: Tt delay, conventional vs novel (Bst 2.0 + Q5) conditions, over the four primer ends the paper tests. The sign runs both ways: a mismatch at the 5' end of FIP (3' end of F1c) can even advance Tt by 1.2 min under the novel polymerase. This is a TOLERANCE magnitude (the mismatch retards, it does not stop) and the range is wide, so no single number transfers.

condition: AS-LAMP, off-allele amplification inside a 75 min run

Discrimination is therefore BINARY (amplify / no amplify) at the primer end used for the allele; the number held is the on-allele detection time, not a ratio.

unit: markers agreeing in full with the predicted digest / markers
axis: binary gel-call agreement with the in-silico digest

Kept as an outcome funnel, not a magnitude; the per-observation count is not printed.
